quote: "Our Holud looked exactly like the mood board we dreamed up on a napkin. Wedding Berries handled every vendor call so our family could just enjoy the evening."
"They ran our Nikah with real respect for how it's meant to flow — nothing rushed, nothing out of order. Our elders noticed, and said so."
"We got married on the beach in Cox's Bazar with guests flying in from three countries. Every single logistic — transport, permits, the lot — was already sorted."
